in_sanskrit.name: Rama
in_sanskrit.meaning: To delight, to please, to be pleased
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delights or pleases others, or one who is pleased or delighted

in_hindi.name: रामु
in_hindi.long_meaning: रामके लिए बड़ा आधा (Rāme kē liē bṛhada ādhā)

in_marathi.name: Ramu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who pleases the gods and people with his actions, a manifestation of Vishnu

in_bengali.name: Ramu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who pleases the gods and people with his actions, a manifestation of Vishnu
